protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: pre-fix SAML.getSession reads SAMLAssertion.Used, rejects only that stale snapshot, then separately calls StateUpdateWithConflicts whose callback unconditionally sets Used=true. Concurrent requests can both pass the outer check and authenticate with one nominally single-use token; ced79da6 fixes this by re-checking Used inside the conflict-retried update callback.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: git log -L for getSession and both exact pickaxes attribute the vulnerable check-then-update sequence's first public write to dfcbaae7d0b7d61d3af526f510db7e233cfb6807. The only intervening c6aaff0f change removes an explicit namespace argument and does not introduce the race.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: dfcbaae7d0b7d61d3af526f510db7e233cfb6807 has no parent header, rev-parse of its parent fails, and rev-list --max-parents=0 --all identifies it as the public repository root.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED: the 227162-line public root is the smallest surviving public object containing the vulnerable function. Its CHANGELOG names private-era SAML commit c0fa5d46f705e73d904b78a5ce4e98dc0b787d0e, but that object is absent from the clone/remote and its exact GitHub commit URL returns 404, so no finer public member can be reconstructed; the primary correctly leaves squash_decomposed=false and uses the surviving root BIC under the protocol exception.
protocol_checks.affected_and_fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: the BIC is an ancestor of vulnerable tags v1.6.5 and v1.7.2. Main fix ced79da6c032d2103803eb53343d0916cc957d2a is not an ancestor of fixed tags v1.6.6 or v1.7.3, but exact cherry-picks 4c4c1e2d8226914f26774a309a91595f168ee921 and 272d3f4dd00e778b39fde09afde35575fe13ef13 respectively are; both release changelogs list 'fix: consume SAML sessions once'.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED: ced79da6c032d2103803eb53343d0916cc957d2a directly changes getSession to reject Used inside StateUpdateWithConflicts and adds concurrent-use coverage; both release commits carry the same diff and identify themselves as cherry-picks of ced79da6.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: CONFIRMED: the BIC commit object has human author and committer Andrey Smirnov, a Signed-off-by trailer, and human Co-Authored-By trailers only. It contains no AI-tool, generated-by, bot, Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT marker; later fix/review activity is excluded from BIC attribution.

findings: The vendor GHSA remains reachable at its exact URL with HTTP 200 and describes the TOCTOU; the frozen GitHub-reviewed advisory record is not withdrawn and lists patched versions 1.6.6 and 1.7.3.
